{
  "up": [
    "Select activities.activity_id, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id",
    "From activities",
    "Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno",
    "Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid",
    "Filter assays.assay_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'",
    "Filter activities.standard_type IS NOT NULL",
    "Filter activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL",
    "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='",
    "Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL",
    "Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'",
    "Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units",
    "Return molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units"
  ]
}
